name: addSocialPostActivityComment
summary: Adds a comment to a post's activity thread.
description: Adds a comment to a post's activity thread. Comments are visible to all users who have access to the post and are typically used for discussion during the approval workflow. The comment appears as a type 3 (comment) entry in the post's activity log.

name: createSocialDraft
summary: Creates a new draft post with content targeting one or more social networks.
description: Creates a new draft post with content targeting one or more social networks. The request body supports multi-channel customization including per-network mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, first comments, polls, and scheduling configuration. Set type=6 for drafts. IMPORTANT: Before calling this endpoint, you MUST first call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed with draft creation if validation returns no errors. This prevents saving drafts with invalid content that will fail when later scheduled or published.Before calling this endpoint, you MUST complete these steps in order: 1. Call getSocialPortals to get the portal ID (use the `id` field from the response). 2. Call getSocialBrands with the portal header to get the brand ID. 3. Call getSocialChannels with portal + brand_id to get available channels and their IDs. 4. Ask the user which channels to post to and what content to publish. 5. If the post includes images, call uploadSocialMedia or uploadSocialMediaFromUrl first and use the returned file IDs in the media_input array. 6. Call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed if validation returns no errors. 7. If validation fails, show the errors to the user and ask them to correct the content before retrying. Do NOT skip validation. Do NOT guess channel IDs - always fetch them from getSocialChannels.

name: createSocialPinterestBoard
summary: Creates a new Pinterest board for the brand's connected Pinterest channel. The board can be created as public or secret. Returns the newly created board object with its id, name, and privacy setting.
description: Creates a new Pinterest board for the brand's connected Pinterest channel. The board can be created as public or secret. Returns the newly created board object with its id, name, and privacy setting.

name: createSocialSchedule
summary: Creates a new scheduled post with content targeting one or more social networks.
description: Creates a new scheduled post with content targeting one or more social networks. The request body supports multi-channel customization including per-network mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, first comments, polls, and scheduling configuration. Set type=1 for normal schedule, type=2 for SmartQ, type=3 for repeat schedule. The schedule_time field is required for scheduled posts. Do not use this endpoint for direct/immediate publishing; use /social/v2/post/publish instead. IMPORTANT: Before calling this endpoint, you MUST first call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed with scheduling if validation returns no errors. This prevents publish failures due to character limits, missing media, invalid board_id, or network-specific constraint violations.Before calling this endpoint, you MUST complete these steps in order: 1. Call getSocialPortals to get the portal ID (use the `id` field from the response). 2. Call getSocialBrands with the portal header to get the brand ID. 3. Call getSocialChannels with portal + brand_id to get available channels and their IDs. 4. Ask the user which channels to post to and what content to publish. 5. If the post includes images, call uploadSocialMedia or uploadSocialMediaFromUrl first and use the returned file IDs in the media_input array. 6. Call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed if validation returns no errors. 7. If validation fails, show the errors to the user and ask them to correct the content before retrying. 8. Ensure the schedule_time is set to a time greater than the current time. Reject requests with schedule times in the past. Do NOT skip validation. Do NOT guess channel IDs - always fetch them from getSocialChannels.

name: deleteSocialDraft
summary: Deletes a draft post by post_id. The draft and all its channel-level content are permanently removed.
description: Deletes a draft post by post_id. The draft and all its channel-level content are permanently removed.

name: deleteSocialSchedule
summary: Deletes a scheduled post by post_id. The scheduled post and all its channel-level content are permanently removed.
description: Deletes a scheduled post by post_id. The scheduled post and all its channel-level content are permanently removed.

name: getPublishStatus
summary: Returns publish status details for a post by post_id, including per-network publish outcome.
description: Returns publish status details for a post by post_id, including per-network publish outcome. Each entry in the response indicates whether the post was successfully published, is still scheduled, or failed for a specific network. When publishing fails, error details including error code and message are provided.

name: getSocialBrands
summary: Fetches social brands accessible to the authenticated user under a given portal.
description: Fetches social brands accessible to the authenticated user under a given portal. Without brand_id, returns all brands in the portal. With brand_id, returns information about that specific brand as a list. Each brand includes connected channels, service associations, timezone, and location details. Requires the portal header to identify the target portal.

name: getSocialChannels
summary: Fetches the channels connected (either in active or reconnect state) in the given brand.
description: Fetches the channels connected (either in active or reconnect state) in the given brand. User must have access (either all or limited channels) to the brand. All validations (space, user, brand) will be carried out. Returns channels with their connection status, publishing capability, and network details.

name: getSocialDraft
summary: Returns the full details of a single draft post by post_id, including channel-level customizations such as mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, and repetition schedule configuration.
description: Returns the full details of a single draft post by post_id, including channel-level customizations such as mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, and repetition schedule configuration.

name: getSocialGeolocations
summary: Searches for geolocations on a specified social network matching the given query string.
description: Searches for geolocations on a specified social network matching the given query string. Returns a list of matching locations with their name, address, coordinates, and platform-specific identifier. The results can be used to populate the geolocations field in channel customizations when composing posts. Supports Facebook and Instagram networks.

name: getSocialMediaLibrary
summary: Returns paginated media assets from the brand's media library.
description: Returns paginated media assets from the brand's media library. Supports filtering by library type (sociallibrary, pixabay, pexels, giphy) and pagination via offset/limit or page/per_page parameters. Each media asset includes file metadata such as format, dimensions, size, and upload time.

name: getSocialNetworkProperties
summary: Returns the basic configurations and functionalities allowed for the given user and brand based on the license and various settings.
description: Returns the basic configurations and functionalities allowed for the given user and brand based on the license and various settings. Provides compose window configurations such as character limits, media constraints, supported features, and validation rules per social network.

name: getSocialPinterestBoards
summary: Returns the Pinterest boards available for a brand's connected Pinterest channel. Boards are paginated and can be filtered by limit. Use the cursor from the response to fetch the next page of results.
description: Returns the Pinterest boards available for a brand's connected Pinterest channel. Boards are paginated and can be filtered by limit. Use the cursor from the response to fetch the next page of results.

name: getSocialPortals
summary: Fetches social portals accessible to the authenticated user.
description: Fetches social portals accessible to the authenticated user. Without portal_id, returns all portals. With portal_id, returns information about that specific portal as a list. Each portal includes brand counts, plan details, user roles, and connected services.

name: getSocialPostActivities
summary: Returns a paginated list of activity entries for a specific post.
description: Returns a paginated list of activity entries for a specific post. Activities include approval submissions, comments, status changes, and post edits. Each activity entry contains the action description, timestamp, the user who performed the action, and optional comment text or media attachments. Use the offset and limit parameters for pagination.

name: getSocialPostCount
summary: Returns aggregate counts of posts for a brand grouped by status.
description: Returns aggregate counts of posts for a brand grouped by status. Provides the total number of draft posts, posts pending approval, scheduled posts, and failed (unpublished) posts. Useful for dashboards, badges, and quick-glance summaries of the publishing pipeline.

name: getSocialPostMentions
summary: Searches for mentionable entities on a specified social network matching the given query string.
description: Searches for mentionable entities on a specified social network matching the given query string. Returns a list of matching profiles, pages, or accounts with their display name, profile picture, and network-specific identifier. The response format varies by network (e.g., Facebook returns followersCount and verified status, Twitter returns followersCount, followingCount, and profile_url, LinkedIn returns userName, Bluesky returns userName).

name: getSocialPublishedPostDetail
summary: Returns the details of a specific published post by its ID from a connected social network.
description: Returns the details of a specific published post by its ID from a connected social network. The response includes the network-native post object with message content, media attachments, engagement metrics (likes, retweets), permalink, and author information. The network query parameter specifies which social network the post belongs to.

name: getSocialPublishedPosts
summary: Returns a cursor-paginated list of published posts for a brand on a specific social network.
description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of published posts for a brand on a specific social network. Each post includes network-native data such as message content, engagement metrics (comments, reactions), media attachments, privacy settings, mentions, geolocation, and the publishing user/application details. Use the `paging.cursor.after` value from the response to fetch the next page.

name: getSocialSchedule
summary: Returns the full details of a single scheduled post by post_id, including channel-level customizations such as mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, and repetition schedule configuration.
description: Returns the full details of a single scheduled post by post_id, including channel-level customizations such as mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, and repetition schedule configuration.

name: getSocialUsers
summary: Fetches the list of users available in a brand.
description: Fetches the list of users available in a brand. Supports filtering by permission type (e.g., REACH_NEW_POST), network names, and user status. Returns user details including role, approval permissions, admin status, and profile image.

name: listSocialDrafts
summary: Returns a paginated list of draft posts for a brand.
description: Returns a paginated list of draft posts for a brand. Supports filtering by social network and user. Results include basic draft metadata such as post ID, message preview, creation time, schedule time, and targeted networks.

name: listSocialSchedules
summary: Returns a paginated list of scheduled posts for a brand.
description: Returns a paginated list of scheduled posts for a brand. Use this endpoint to fetch all schedules, the approval list (is_approval=true), and failed posts (is_failed=true). Supports filtering by social network and post type. Results include basic post metadata such as post ID, message preview, creation time, schedule time, and targeted networks.

name: publishSocialPost
summary: Publishes a post immediately to one or more social networks.
description: Publishes a post immediately to one or more social networks. This is equivalent to creating a scheduled post for immediate execution. The request body uses the same messages structure as create schedule, supporting channel-level customizations such as mentions, geolocations, media attachments, link previews, first comments, and polls. IMPORTANT: Before calling this endpoint, you MUST first call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed with publishing if validation returns no errors. This prevents publish failures due to character limits, missing media, invalid board_id, or network-specific constraint violations.Before calling this endpoint, you MUST complete these steps in order: 1. Call getSocialPortals to get the portal ID (use the `id` field from the response). 2. Call getSocialBrands with the portal header to get the brand ID. 3. Call getSocialChannels with portal + brand_id to get available channels and their IDs. 4. Ask the user which channels to post to and what content to publish. 5. If the post includes images, call uploadSocialMedia or uploadSocialMediaFromUrl first and use the returned file IDs in the media_input array. 6. Call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed if validation returns no errors. 7. If validation fails, show the errors to the user and ask them to correct the content before retrying. Do NOT skip validation. Do NOT guess channel IDs - always fetch them from getSocialChannels.

name: updateSocialDraft
summary: Updates an existing draft post. Can change content, schedule, channels, or convert a draft (type=6) to a scheduled post (type=1).
description: Updates an existing draft post. Can change content, schedule, channels, or convert a draft (type=6) to a scheduled post (type=1). The post_id must be included in the request path. IMPORTANT: Before calling this endpoint, you MUST first call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed with updating the draft if validation returns no errors. This prevents update failures due to character limits, missing media, invalid board_id, or network-specific constraint violations.Before calling this endpoint, you MUST complete these steps: 1. Call getSocialPortals to get the portal ID if not already known. 2. Call getSocialBrands to get the brand ID if not already known. 3. Fetch the existing draft using getSocialDraft with the post_id to get current content. 4. Show the current content to the user and ask what they want to change. 5. Merge user changes into the existing post body (preserve all unchanged fields). 6. Call validateSocialPost with the updated post body. Only proceed if validation returns no errors. Do NOT send a partial body - always include the complete messages array with all unchanged fields preserved.

name: updateSocialPostApprovalStatus
summary: Changes the approval status of a post in the approval workflow.
description: Changes the approval status of a post in the approval workflow. Supported status transitions include moving a post to "Yet to Review", "In Review", "Approved", or "Rejected". When rejecting a post (statusType=6), an optional approvalComments field can be included to provide feedback. The status change is recorded as an activity entry in the post's activity log.Before calling this endpoint: 1. You must have a post_id for a post that is currently in the approval workflow. 2. Get the post's current approval status from getSocialPostActivities. 3. Valid status transitions: pending -> approved, pending -> rejected. 4. Ask the user to confirm the approval/rejection decision. 5. If rejecting, ask for a rejection reason to include in the approvalComments field. Do NOT approve or reject posts without explicit user confirmation.

name: updateSocialSchedule
summary: Updates an existing scheduled post. Can change content, schedule time, channels, or post type.
description: Updates an existing scheduled post. Can change content, schedule time, channels, or post type. The post_id must be included in the request path and in the request body under post.post_id. IMPORTANT: Before calling this endpoint, you MUST first call validateSocialPost with the same post body. Only proceed with updating the schedule if validation returns no errors. This prevents update failures due to character limits, missing media, invalid board_id, or network-specific constraint violations.Before calling this endpoint, you MUST complete these steps: 1. Call getSocialPortals to get the portal ID if not already known. 2. Call getSocialBrands to get the brand ID if not already known. 3. Fetch the existing post using getSocialSchedule with the post_id to get current content. 4. Show the current content to the user and ask what they want to change. 5. Merge user changes into the existing post body (preserve all unchanged fields). 6. Call validateSocialPost with the updated post body. Only proceed if validation returns no errors. 7. If validation fails, show the errors to the user and ask them to correct the content before retrying. 8. Ensure the schedule_time is set to a time greater than the current time. Reject requests with schedule times in the past. Do NOT send a partial body - always include the complete messages array with all unchanged fields preserved.

name: uploadSocialMedia
summary: Uploads an image file to the brand's media library.
description: Uploads an image file to the brand's media library. Supports two request modes: multipart/form-data with the raw binary file, or application/json with a base64-encoded file content string. The response contains the file ID and image path which should be used when attaching media to post schedules or drafts. IMPORTANT: When using the base64 JSON mode, pass the COMPLETE base64 string with no truncation, ellipsis, shortening, or omission. Do not trim, cut, summarize, or replace any part of the base64 stream.Before calling this endpoint: 1. Ensure you have the portal ID (from getSocialPortals) and brand_id (from getSocialBrands). 2. Supported image formats: PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPG. 3. The response returns a file ID - store it for use in the media_input array when creating schedules, drafts, or publishing posts. 4. Use multipart/form-data with the binary file, or application/json with a base64-encoded file string and optional file_name. 5. CRITICAL - Do NOT trim, truncate, shorten, summarize, or omit any part of the base64 image stream. Pass the full uninterrupted base64 string (including the data:image/...;base64, prefix when present). Truncated base64 produces corrupt uploads and failed posts. Never replace the middle or end with "...". After upload, confirm the file ID with the user before proceeding to post creation.

name: uploadSocialMediaFromUrl
summary: Uploads an image to the brand's media library from a remote URL.
description: Uploads an image to the brand's media library from a remote URL. The response contains the file ID and image path which should be used when attaching media to post schedules or drafts.Before calling this endpoint: 1. Ensure you have the portal ID (from getSocialPortals) and brand_id (from getSocialBrands). 2. Supported image formats: PNG, GIF, JPEG, JPG. 3. The response returns a file ID - store it for use in the media_input array when creating schedules, drafts, or publishing posts. 4. Pass the image URL in the JSON body as image_url. After upload, confirm the file ID with the user before proceeding to post creation.

name: validateSocialPost
summary: Validates a post object before scheduling or publishing.
description: Validates a post object before scheduling or publishing. Accepts the same request body structure as create schedule or create draft. Returns validation results indicating whether the post content meets all network-specific requirements such as character limits, media constraints, and channel configurations. This endpoint MUST be called before createSocialSchedule, publishSocialPost, createSocialDraft, updateSocialDraft, or updateSocialSchedule. Pass the exact same post body you intend to schedule, publish, or update. Only proceed if validation returns no errors.
